willing to do this.

Best,

Jonathan

messages.subject: UT Austin Student & PGN Member Interested in Banking @ Goldman New York
messages.body:
Hello Sam,

I hope you are doing well. I am a Fall PC ‘22 PGN member studying Business and Economics, and I'm pursuing a career in Investment Banking. I'd love to talk to you to learn more about your experience at Goldman in New York. I am particularly interested in Banking in New York, so I would greatly appreciate the opportunity to speak with you.

If you have any free time in the next week, it would be great to set up a quick phone call with you. I am pretty open and can likely adjust my schedule to accommodate whatever works best for you. Please let me know if you would be willing to do this. Attached is my resume.

Best,
Jonathan

messages.subject: UT Austin Student Interested in Investment Banking @ Houlihan
messages.body:
Hello Sam,

I hope you are doing well. I am an undergraduate Economics student at the University of Texas, and I'm pursuing a career in Investment Banking. I'd love to talk to you to learn more about your experience at Houlihan in New York. I am particularly interested in hearing from you given you successfully entered banking without a business degree as I'm attempting to do the same.

If you have any free time in the next week, it would be great to set up a quick phone call with you. I am pretty open and can likely adjust my schedule to accommodate whatever works best for you. Please let me know if you would be willing to do this. Attached is my resume.

Best,
Jonathan

messages.subject: RE: UT Austin Student Interested in Investment Banking @ Houlihan
messages.body:
Jonathan,

Thank you for reaching out and for your interest Houlihan Lokey Restructuring’s 2025 Summer Analyst Program in New York. I am copying into this email our recruiting team who is running point on this process – if you have not shared your resume here, please reply to this email with a copy.

This email confirms that we have noted your interest and will review your resume and be in touch if there are any next steps. From a process standpoint, if you have already reached out to others in the NY restructuring team, that is fine, but going forward please direct all communications to the recruiting team. Thank you again for your interest.

Best,
Sam

Samuel Ward, Houlihan Lokey

messages.body:
Hey Josh,

Thanks for spending the time to speak with me today about your recruiting
process and experience at FT Partners. You provided some very valuable
insight into the industry for me. If you could either connect me with or
forward along the contact info of the analyst at FT who interned in Houston
for a summer and then re-recruited that would be great. Additionally, I'll
definitely be applying to FT when applications open up down the road.
Thanks again!

Best,
Jonathan

messages.subject: Nice Meeting You & Potential Call (Econ Student)
messages.body:
Hello John,

It was great to meet you yesterday – I appreciate you spending the time to provide me with some valuable insight. I know you spoke with many students yesterday, so you likely don't specifically remember me. I was one of the Econ students who spoke with you about the feasibility of breaking into Banking without being a McCombs major. Additionally, I am particularly interested in working in New York as opposed to Houston. Therefore, I am following up to see if we could hop on a quick call so I can better understand Intrepid's recruiting process and learn a little more about your experience.

If you have any free time in the next week, I would love to hop on a quick phone call with you. I am pretty open and can likely adjust my schedule to accommodate whatever works best for you. Please let me know if you would be willing to do this. Attached is my resume.

Best,
Jonathan

messages.subject: RE: Nice Meeting You & Potential Call (Econ Student)
messages.body:
Hi Jonathan,

Likewise, it was nice meeting you too. I have copied a few others from Intrepid who help out with recruiting. Gary and Reed were with me yesterday, but I have also copied Brett Bemis (Associate), Kevin Cook (Senior Analyst), and Will Robinson (Analyst). They are all UT alumni. Brett / Kevin / Reed are based in Houston, and Gary / Will are in New York. I think they will be helpful in providing their perspective on the internship and our analyst program.

You should try to attend our info session on February 6th from 5:30 – 6:30pm CT in UTC 3.102. I can introduce you to a few others then.

Have a great weekend!

John Sellingsloh

messages.subject: Re: Nice Meeting You & Potential Call (Econ Student)
messages.body:
John – I appreciate you connecting me to some of the appropriate contacts at Intrepid. I will reach out to them directly to learn more about the firm and gain some additional recruiting insight. In the meantime, I'll be in attendance at the info session on February 6th. I look forward to seeing you then. Thanks again!

Best,
Jonathan

Hello Kevin,

I hope you are doing well. My name is Jonathan Nachman, and I'm a
sophomore Economics and Business Student at The University of Texas,
Austin.

I was speaking with your daughter, Zoe, last night at a Chadwick dinner,
where I learned of our mutual interest in pursuing Investment Banking. She
had mentioned to me your role at Houlihan and expressed your willingness to
be a point of contact for me.

Coincidentally, I was on the phone today with Kate Borden, another Chadwick
alum and current analyst at Houlihan LA (CFR group). I am extremely
interested in your firm and would love to set up a quick phone call to gain
some more insight from you as a more senior banker. Please let me know if
you have any time to call next week.

Best,
Jonathan

--
*Jonathan Nachman *
University of Texas, Austin
Economics & Business

messages.subject: [Josh Gumm Referral] UT Austin Student Interested in Banking @ FT
messages.body:
Hello Ethan,

I hope you are doing well. My name is Jonathan Nachman, and I'm an
Economics and Business student at the University of Texas, Austin. I had
the opportunity to speak to Josh Gumm on the phone yesterday regarding the
Summer Analyst Internship program at FT Partners, where he filled me in
briefly on your background. Given your unique experience spending a summer
as an Analyst in Houston to ultimately re-recruiting, I think you could
provide me with some very valuable insight coming from UT.

If you have any free time in the next week, I would love to set up a quick
phone call with you. I am pretty open and can likely adjust my schedule to
accommodate whatever works best for you. Please let me know if you would be
willing to do this. Attached is my resume.

Best,
Jonathan

*Jonathan Nachman *
University of Texas, Austin
Economics & Business
M: (310)-292-4712
